name: Pixelhue Media-Server

actions.name: program
actions.description: Selects the program slot to play: stores it as the module's current program id and sends control tag 366 with the program id (4 bytes).

actions.name: pause_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 133 with the current program id (the one last chosen with the program action, initially 0).

actions.name: play_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 271 with the current program id (the one last chosen with the program action, initially 0).

actions.name: stop_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 272 with the current program id (the one last chosen with the program action, initially 0).

actions.name: open_ftb
actions.description: Sends control tag 260 (no data).

actions.name: close_ftb
actions.description: Sends control tag 261 (no data).

actions.name: open_volume
actions.description: Sends control tag 262 (no data).

actions.name: close_volume
actions.description: Sends control tag 263 (no data).

actions.name: ppt_pgup
actions.description: Sends control tag 286 with trigger id 0.

actions.name: ppt_pgdn
actions.description: Sends control tag 287 with trigger id 0.

actions.name: volume_up
actions.description: Sends control tag 328 with a fixed step of 5 (VOLUME_STEP).

actions.name: volume_down
actions.description: Sends control tag 329 with a fixed step of 5 (VOLUME_STEP).

actions.name: brightness_up
actions.description: Sends control tag 391 with data 0x01 and a fixed step of 2 (BRIGHTNESS_STEP).

actions.name: brightness_down
actions.description: Sends control tag 391 with data 0x00 and a fixed step of 2 (BRIGHTNESS_STEP).

actions.name: play
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with data 0.

actions.name: pause
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with data 1.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with data 2.

actions.name: open_test_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 258 (no data).
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: close_test_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 259 (no data).
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: previous_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 388 with data 0.
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: next_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 388 with data 1.
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: bind_media
actions.description: Sends control tag 10004 with program and layer index (2 bytes each, little endian). Registers the button for the Bind Media feedback (subscribe/unsubscribe).
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: bind_cue_tag
actions.description: Sends control tag 10005 with the cue index.
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: score_up
actions.description: Raises the score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media): control tag 10039, type 0x01, value = step.

options.label: Step
options.description: Amount to increase the score by each time

actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: score_down
actions.description: Lowers the score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media): control tag 10039, type 0xFF, value = step.

options.label: Step
options.description: Amount to decrease the score by each time

actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: score_reset
actions.description: Resets the main score of the currently selected scoreboard media: control tag 10041, no data.
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: score_undo
actions.description: Undoes the last step of the currently selected scoreboard media: control tag 10042, no data.
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: score_set
actions.description: Sets the main score of the currently selected scoreboard media to the given value: control tag 10040 (2 bytes). The module clamps the value to 0-999 (clampValues).
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: select_media
actions.description: Selects a media by program and layer: control tag 10038 (program id in the low 4 bytes, layer id in the high 4 bytes). Registers the button for the Selected Media feedback (subscribe/unsubscribe).
actions.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (getAllActions, ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js).

feedbacks.name: Selected Media
feedbacks.description: Show this button's Select Media action program and layer
feedbacks.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (updateFeedbacks in src/main.js).

feedbacks.name: Bind Media
feedbacks.description: Show this button's Bind Media action program and layer
feedbacks.availability: Only registered when the Model setting is ms3pro (updateFeedbacks in src/main.js).

notes: Complete list: 17 actions from getActions() and 12 more from getAllActions() (src/actions.js) plus 2 advanced feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js). Which set is registered depends on the Model setting (src/main.js:27-37): model ms3pro gets all 29 actions and both feedbacks, any other value gets only the 17 base actions and no feedbacks. Commented-out code in actions.js (set_volume, open_layer_volume, close_layer_volume, refresh, update_program, take_program, cut_program) is not registered and not catalogued.

Protocol: UDP to the media server (config host, default 192.168.0.10; port, default "18960"; the module binds locally to 0.0.0.0:18961). Every action sends one binary control frame built by encodeControlProtocol (utils/cmdCodec.js) with a numeric tag; the tag per action is in its description. The module never reads device state except the program list request (tag 129) at start, whose result is not used.

Config fields (src/main.js:145-179): info (static text), host (textinput, Regex.IP, default 192.168.0.10), port (textinput, Regex.PORT, default "18960"), modelId (dropdown, choices ms3pro "Pilot MS3 Pro" and ms3 "Pilot MS3", default ms3pro). init() reads this.config.modelID (capital D) while the field id is modelId; updateActions/updateFeedbacks use modelId.

The program dropdowns offer ids 0-255 as numbers (PROGRAM_CHOICES, label "ProgramId N", src/actions.js:5); the layer dropdowns offer the strings "0" to "49" (label "layerId N") while the program default is the number 0 and the layer default is the string "0". The ids keep their source type here.
pause_program, play_program and stop_program act on instance.programId, which is only set by the program action (initial value 0); they have no options.
score_set declares asInteger and clampValues (clamping is not part of the catalog schema). Option tooltips are recorded as description.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.15.1: options do not support expressions. Names are the source names, which equal the action ids.
